purpose: Preserve the context of each book strictly from the Bible essénienne PDF corpus so thematic search can interpret a psalm occurrence inside its book without introducing external information.

sourcePolicy.rule: Every book-context statement and thematic interpretation must be derived only from material present in the authoritative PDF: book title, Archangel attribution, introductions or editorial context present in the PDF, psalm titles, psalm text, editorial notes, order of texts and relevant annex material. No website, secondary Essene source, commentary, memory or external doctrinal material may enrich, confirm or correct this layer.

analysisPolicy.rule: Describe what the text teaches, associates, distinguishes, prescribes, warns against or symbolizes without judging whether its claims are true or false and without importing an external doctrinal framework.
analysisPolicy.inferenceRule: Indirect themes and book-level syntheses are allowed only when supported by multiple or sufficiently clear textual signals. Record them as interpretation rather than textual fact when appropriate.
analysisPolicy.ambiguityRule: When two materially different readings remain plausible from the PDF, do not force a conclusion; register the ambiguity in data/incoherences.json for human review.
analysisPolicy.languageRule: Use descriptive formulations such as 'le texte présente', 'le psaume associe' or 'Gabriel enseigne dans ce passage' rather than adopting the claim as an external fact.

interpretationRule: A theme occurrence is first grounded in the psalm and verses. Book context is a second interpretive layer derived only from the PDF and used to explain emphasis, sense, relations and ranking. It must never manufacture a theme absent from the psalm.

fields.centralAxis: Overall movement or question inferred from the complete book inside the PDF.
fields.contextThemes: Themes that structure the book as a whole according to PDF evidence.
fields.interpretiveLens: How belonging to this book can nuance a thematic occurrence, based only on PDF evidence.
fields.archangelContribution: Contribution observable in this book only; never supplemented from external sources.
